description: Fail-before / pass-after runs of the regression tests named in the article. before = first parent of the merge commit plus only the pull request's test change; after = merge commit. The df24917-budget-nohook case adds separate hook-free test functions to both commits. Outcomes are parsed from the logs listed here.
parser: make_results.py rev 3 (2026-10-30): PASS requires the named test to have been executed; ignored-only or skipped-only runs are NO_TESTS_RUN; a summary line that disagrees with the per-test lines is UNKNOWN; every case needs a before and an after record; a record with setup_error is SETUP_ERROR and leaves its case incomplete; a case is also incomplete when the latest invocation in logs/requested.json that requested it has no record for a requested side. Revision 3 recognises the literal $FAILBEFORE_WORK/ prefix like an absolute path for Maven test-source errors; re-running it over all retained logs changes no historical outcome.
